exposure: women who had a vaginal delivery
women who underwent induction of labor
women who had a cesarean delivery
outcome: need for extracorporeal membrane oxygenation treatment
cohort: 193 SARS-CoV-2-positive pregnant women treated at the study hospital between April 2020 and February 2021
finding: Among 193 SARS-CoV-2-positive pregnant women, COVID-19 symptoms were common, but severe outcomes were rare, and neonatal outcomes were generally favorable.
mod_finding: Of 144 women who delivered during the study period, 29 (20%) underwent cesarean delivery.
